tagline: A local, verifiable execution and coordination layer for AI coding agents.
release_status: untagged; P3 gate partial (Codex automatic + manual hand-off)

integration_modes.name: Native execution (automatic worker)
integration_modes.summary: A built-in adapter starts a CLI coding agent non-interactively and collects structured events.
integration_modes.requires: a provider manifest in this build, the vendor CLI installed and signed in, and an absolute executable path configured
integration_modes.human_in_the_loop: configuring the provider and approving each write task's permission
integration_modes.limitations: Only the adapters listed under worker_adapters have code. MCP does not make a tool a native worker.

integration_modes.name: Protocol-connected coordinator
integration_modes.summary: An MCP-capable client calls the Kernel's 21 tools over stdio to submit, follow and review tasks.
integration_modes.requires: an MCP client that can start a stdio server and pass tool calls
integration_modes.human_in_the_loop: installing the MCP snippet and choosing the approval_mode/grant policy
integration_modes.limitations: MCP connects a coordinator to PAR. It is not a generic automatic-worker protocol, and each client brand needs its own evidence.

integration_modes.name: Manual hand-off
integration_modes.summary: PAR exports a private workspace plus PROMPT.md; a person runs a GUI/web/mobile tool and imports a workspace, patch or text result.
integration_modes.requires: the external tool can open the exported workspace, or read/write a supported patch, or return text
integration_modes.human_in_the_loop: opening the tool, doing the work, exporting/importing the result
integration_modes.evidence_level: client-specific for VERIFIED_MANUAL; otherwise a generic conditional path
integration_modes.limitations: A text-only tool can participate in R0/R1; a code change needs an importable patch or workspace and is still re-checked by the Kernel.

worker_adapters.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
worker_adapters.limitations: Only this version/OS/account combination; the vendor CLI is alpha; reads are not restricted by its sandbox; not verified on Linux or Windows.

worker_adapters.name: Google Antigravity CLI (agy)
worker_adapters.auth: Google login via the system keychain
worker_adapters.limitations: Disabled by default. The vendor FAQ prohibits wrapping agy in third-party coding agents under consumer plans; not a recommended automatic path.

coordinator_clients.name: Claude Desktop
coordinator_clients.limitations: Real evidence covers tool discovery and a read-only list_tasks call. Submit/decision tools are covered by scripted MCP tests, not by a real Claude session; vendor builds change.

coordinator_clients.name: Codex CLI (as coordinator)
coordinator_clients.limitations: Real evidence covers tool discovery and a read-only list_tasks call through codex exec. Submit/decision tools are scripted-tested only.

coordinator_clients.name: Other MCP-capable clients
coordinator_clients.limitations: The protocol is implemented and the tool schemas are public, but no other client brand has been verified; do not read this as per-brand support.

coordinator_clients.name: A person at the CLI
coordinator_clients.limitations: The CLI 'user' identity is a protocol-level actor label, not unforgeable human authentication.

manual_clients.name: WorkBuddy
manual_clients.limitations: One real R2 hand-off sample; not an automated adapter and not re-verified on other versions.

manual_clients.name: TRAE
manual_clients.limitations: Documented conditional path; no dated export/import evidence in this repository.

manual_clients.name: Cursor
manual_clients.limitations: Conditional on opening the exported workspace and returning an importable result; not verified.

manual_clients.name: Windsurf
manual_clients.limitations: Conditional on opening the exported workspace and returning an importable result; not verified.

manual_clients.name: Cline
manual_clients.limitations: Conditional on opening the exported workspace and returning an importable result; not verified.

manual_clients.name: Aider
manual_clients.limitations: Conditional on producing a valid patch within the task's allowed paths; not verified.

manual_clients.name: Web or mobile chat assistants
manual_clients.limitations: Text-only participation in R0/R1. Without a workspace or a valid patch they cannot perform a verified R2 code change.

host_os.name: macOS 15.6.1 arm64
host_os.sandbox: No OS sandbox; private clone only

host_os.name: Linux (ubuntu-latest, GitHub Actions)
host_os.install: pip install -e . in linux_security_core (smoke_install itself is macOS)

not_supported: Every coding assistant being automatically supported
Native execution on all operating systems
Automatic application of patches to a real project
MCP as a generic automatic-worker protocol
OS-level sandboxing of Workers or check commands
Unforgeable human identity for the CLI 'user' actor
